C1372.title: Shandong Qingdao Mnemonic Memory Theft Case: 107 BTC Stolen
C1372.summary: In July 2023, defendant Zhang used the opportunity of assisting Feng with a digital wallet transaction to secretly memorize 11 complete words and one initial while Feng copied 12 mnemonic words. That night, Zhang brute-forced the remaining word, controlled the wallet, transferred 107 bitcoins, and converted them through a cryptocurrency exchange platform. The court sentenced Zhang for theft; specific prison term, fine, and second-instance result should only be included after adding later judgment sources.
